Join the PPP & become the most technical player in your team guaranteed: https://www.skool.com/theproplayerpathway

➡️ If this is your first video: I'm Jamie Breen. I get paid to play football and do what I love.

At the same time, I help young footballers become the most technical player on their team, so they play with confidence and stand out every time they step onto the pitch through the proven TouchMax System.

It hasn't always been like this. At 10 years old, I broke my leg in two places and lost all my confidence. It stayed that way for six years. I was this close to quitting.

That's when I started building the training system that would eventually become the TouchMax System. During the second lockdown in the UK, I trained every day and leapfrogged every player around me. By the time the world had reopened, I was a completely new player.

My touches were cleaner, the ball felt glued to my feet, and I could do everything I wanted to do with the football.

As a result, I went on to earn first-team opportunities with Barnet F.C. while playing for the academy. Now, I'm playing semi-professional football for Leighton Town F.C..

This was only possible because of the TouchMax System.

snippet.title: Positional game Split the line #drills #football #soccer
snippet.description:
Positional game designed to train playing through the opponent’s defensive block

By Jonatan Germano @shonygermano and Shane Rexhepi @shane.rexhepi at Avondale FC @avondalefc84 

The attacking team must find the moment to split the defensive block and progress into the next zone.

The defending team stays compact and protects the passing lanes.

Football is about finding the extra line-breaking pass.
